trajectory.thought: The series has a strong trend and unstable model rankings (tau=0.041), which suggests that simple averaging might be too sensitive to individual model biases or errors. A robust combination method like DBA (Deviation From Average) is designed to mitigate this by focusing on the deviation of each model from the ensemble mean, effectively down-weighting outliers and handling instability better than standard mean or median. I will test DBA on the full pool as a baseline for robustness.

The series has a strong trend (0.882) and unstable rankings across windows. DBA worked well, but given the high correlation among transform-based models and the dominance of catboost/rf in recent trends, I will test a weighted combination focusing on inverse error weighting to let the best performers dominate while still combining them. This tests if simple error-inversion outperforms the robustness of DBA when rankings are unstable but top models are distinct.
